subject: b3a8 decision: (a)-direction, but NOT a GPU capability; (b) alone cannot light the panel
body: Evidence: (1) c6ec kernel log shows CA PRESENTS b3a8 frames: 'SWEET FB: swap N layer 0 surface 2/3 1125x2436 fmt 0x62336138 bpr 4544'. (2) Kernel present (build/xnu-stage/iokit/Kernel/arm/SweetFramebuffer.cpp ~l.458-500) copies raw bytes per bpe with NO b3a8->panel conversion (only a non_bgra diag counter; NOTES.md:7818 'no conversion added'). So even perfect GPU XR rendering (option b) would show wrong colours; b needs a kernel change too. Black (not garbage) means surfaces stay zero = CA drew nothing into them: our newTextureWithDescriptor:iosurface:plane: only admits pixelFormat 80/1-plane, so the b3a8 import returns nil silently. (3) Format choice is not keyed on the GPU caps we answer: TEGU_DEVQ already returns 0 for Apple3..Apple8 (1003-1008) and CA still chose b3a8; the earlier CPU-renderer boot (NOTES ~8184) created 1125x2436 BGRA stride 4608 with the same kernel. So CA picks b3a8 when its Metal renderer is active + the display looks wide-gamut (iPhone X profile). Determining the exact key needs QuartzCore from the dyld cache (not on host; offline extraction, no mount) - likely an IOMFB/display property served by SweetFramebuffer or a CA default. Recommendation: (a) via kernel/display-property owner or CA preference, NOT a GPU capability lie; (b) is a large multi-owner feature (Mali arch9 has no XR10 RT format: needs RGBA16F shadow + exact XR encode + A8 plane + kernel conversion) - not for this run. I am adding an always-on bounded TEGU_IOSURFACE_REFUSED trace (desc fmt/usage/options, fourcc, planes, row, alloc) so the next run states the exact descriptor CA uses. Continuing unbound-slot fix, stride/level/value traces.
